content.text: The redline validates. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Two walk-away features. First, Section (c) ASSIGNMENT (p0149) imposes a blanket prohibition on Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard on Licensor's consent, and imposes no restriction at all on Licensor's own assignment — so the clause is neither at the preferred nor the fallback (which requires a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice). Second, Article XX (p0134) makes our Change of Control — expressly defined to include an asset sale, merger or equity transfer — an event of automatic termination of the Agreement and of all our licenses absent Licensor's prior written consent, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing where the acquirer competes with it or where it merely "believes" its interests are affected. A Vendor right to terminate on Customer change of control is expressly walk-away. The redline adds the Affiliate/successor carve-out with notice, makes the consent standard reciprocal and not unreasonably withheld (and bars assignment to our competitors), and removes the change-of-control termination trigger while preserving Licensor's consent right over other assignments. (Article XXII's right of first refusal on an M&A transaction is a separate commercial issue not addressed under this rule.)

ops.oldText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity, upon written notice to Licensor. Licensee may not otherwise assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, and in no event to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) of Licensee shall not require Licensor's consent and shall not give Licensor any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise modify this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder. Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control promptly following its consummation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added our standard carve-out permitting assignment to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger or asset sale (with notice), made the consent standard reciprocal and reasonable, and removed the automatic termination triggered by our Change of Control. A blanket bar on our assignment with no M&A carve-out, and a Vendor exit right on our change of control, are walk-away positions for us; we are content for Licensor's consent right over other assignments to remain, and for Licensor not to assign to our competitors.
proposal.summary: Add Affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Licensee, make consent mutual and reasonable, and delete Licensor's change-of-control termination right.
